correctness.rationale: Minkowski support additivity and sorted gap decomposition yield exact width and a strict equality classification by nonparallel centered cut rays. Exact crossing counts give the finite formula; fixed, macroscopic and intermediate cut asymptotics prove min(c,2), and an exponentially small balanced hyperedge omission plus the positive denominator gap gives eventual exact balanced minimizers for c>2. The enumerating checker verifies 203 small mixed cuts and their support widths, 630 independent directions, 11,172 finite (n,k) profiles, and 16 off-critical large-scale profiles. These tests corroborate but do not certify the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The objects are the standard uniform hyper-permutahedra of Agnarsson, and minimum Euclidean width is an intrinsic metric invariant. The theorem supplies an all-parameter exact cut-formula with complete normal equality cases, and an off-critical sharp k~c sqrt(n) phase change from singleton to balanced cuts. These are distinct geometric regimes and provide an infinite-family classification not supplied by face/flag enumeration.
